preface.title: Preface
preface.para: This is the main documentation for the subclass project, an Ironclad licensed Maven archetype demonstrating best practices in software licensing and build automation.

chapter.title: Introduction
chapter.para: The subclass project serves as an archetype for creating new Java/Maven projects with strict licensing compliance, REUSE specification adherence, and automated quality gates.
